operations.body: Entry 1144 is complete, event ev-000000000861-8e383b69-f131-4aa6-a77a-5f0917951c6b. The complete object is forced by t=p*s*(B-1) to be the internal conductor complex [Z/4 --2--> Z/4] tensored with Entry 1104's augmented three-face simplex. I derived an explicit integral simplex contraction and the signed tensor homotopy K(c_p⊗s)=(-1)^p c_p⊗h(s); DK+KD=1 on all 16 basis vectors mod 4. Thus Entry 1143's two local Z/2 grades are genuine associated-grade data but cancel in complete supported totalization. The second-center branch is closed through finite coefficients, with no new carrier or physical class.
